mapper.select: SELECT file.sys10_file_id FROM ( SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} UNION SELECT sys10_file.* FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys11_file_id WHERE sys11_parent_id = #{parentId} ) AS file ORDER BY COALESCE(sys10_file_yn, 'false') ASC, LPAD(COALESCE(sys10_seq, '99999'), 5, '0'), COALESCE(sys10_title_yn, 'false') DESC, sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys11_relate_file ( sys11_relate_file_id, sys11_file_id, sys11_parent_id, sys11_parent_table ) VALUES ( #{relateFileId}, #{fileId}, #{apprId}, 'apr01_appr' )
